info.title: Medical Device Training Certification API
info.description: Azure-hosted same-origin /api/v1 integration. Entra API access tokens are required except auth/config and public credential verification. The API owns progress, scores and model state. Model actions use HTTP 200 for accepted and rejected semantic outcomes. This document is generated with the application build; deployment and physical-device evidence are tracked separately.
